title: Building Groovie, an Advanced Web-Based Drum Machine / Beat Sequencer
excerpt: Building Groovie, an Advanced Web-Based Drum Machine / Beat Sequencer
content_html:
August 6th, 2026

This is a blog post about a new music app called Groovie that I put together over the last few weeks. All the way back in 2012, I built MusicToy, one of the earliest JavaScript music apps on the web. This is a very simple sequencer that uses a pentatonic scale and a few samples. It's designed to be very intuitive for beginners. The reason I say one of the earliest is that this app actually predates the Web Audio API. The first version used the now long-deprecated Mozilla Audio Data API. What's interesting about it though is that MusicToy allows you to share songs without using any kind of backend. It's a fully static website, but it can encode patterns into the hash/fragment part of the URL (a cool, still underrated web trick).

Since then, I've created several more advanced web-based music apps, the most advanced one being NoiseCraft. NoiseCraft has sequencer nodes with multiple selectable patterns. However, it's extremely tedious to build a song from a single long pattern. Something that I've felt was lacking is a way to chain multiple patterns together, in part because it wasn't clear to me back then how to do that cleanly in terms of user interface design. With this project, I wanted to finally tackle that problem.

Groovie is a drum/beat sequencer app that uses samples and has a number of advanced features. I built it because I saw kind of a gap in the market. There are many drum machines out there on the web, but most of them are very basic with a fixed drum kit and a single pattern. Some of them are more advanced, but they're often ad-ridden or require a paid account. The few more advanced ones that don't have those issues often have confusing user interfaces. Groovie has 150+ samples to select from, up to 32 patterns, and a timeline view that allows sequencing multiple patterns over time, and playing multiple patterns at the same time. The patterns can have variable lengths and create polyrhythms. It also has a low-pass/high-pass filter, delay, and per-sample volume and panning, among other features. It does all of this while maintaining a pretty intuitive UI with a responsive layout that's still usable even on a mobile phone, and best of all, it's open source, and free forever.

Here are some example pieces/beats:

  • Berlin-techno arrangement

  • Drill and bass arrangement

  • House groove panned wide

  • Rock music arrangement

  • The classic Amen Break

  • A drum and bass beat

Like MusicToy, Groovie is fully static and encodes patterns and projects directly into the fragment part of URLs. However, it's packing a lot more information into that space, with projects that can have up to 32 patterns, selectable samples, and a timeline that can span thousands of steps. As such, I made a genuine effort to be clever with the way this information is encoded. I wanted to target a total link length limit of 2000 chars to keep links shareable on social media platforms and messaging services, or a budget of about 1800 characters for the fragment part. Using a base64url encoding, that leaves us 6 bits of information per character, or 10,800 bits in total. I find that encouraging, because I know from experience that you can actually encode a lot of information in that many bits.

The song title is encoded in a format that's still human-readable for convenience, with spaces replaced by underscores, and markdown characters intentionally excluded to avoid potential formatting errors when links are included in markdown documents. Groovie's encoding uses 4 bits to write a version number, which means there's room for incrementing this number to add new features or encoding improvements to Groovie without breaking older shared links.

A pattern with one row per sample, and say 16 steps in length, is mostly just a grid, which can be naively encoded as a bitmap. I say naively because if you have 32 samples and 64 steps in length, that's already 2048 bits, meaning we bust the 10,800 bit budget with only a handful of patterns and no other data. We also need to encode the index of the samples for each row, which at the moment I'm using 9 bits for, allowing for up to 512 samples. Then each row can also have stereo panning, volume and effect send settings, which also take a few bits each to encode. The timeline itself can also be essentially represented as a bitmap, with one row per pattern, and one bit for each position where a pattern could be playing or not. Groovie uses a few clever tricks to try to encode this information using far fewer bits than a raw bitmap.

When trying to optimize something, I think it's very helpful to have a set of benchmarks to give you useful metrics. I used a coding assistant to put together a corpus with about a dozen different songs, as well as a utility script to measure how many bytes are needed to encode each song, along with the total for the whole corpus. What quickly became clear is that most of the data that needs to be encoded is in the patterns. Here there are many tricks that we can use. Patterns are often repetitive, for example with a kick drum that repeats every N steps. They can also be sparse, for example with a cymbal hit that happens only once in a 16-step pattern. Or you can have the same kick drum beat reused in multiple patterns.

What Groovie does here is it uses a few bits, for each row of a pattern, to select among 8 different encoding strategies for that row. A variable-length prefix code is used to encode the strategy. One strategy is to just repeat the same short motif along the whole length of the row. Another is to record the exact position of sparse hits. There is also a fallback to storing a literal bitmap of the row. Then there is another strategy which reuses all of the data from the same row in the previous pattern, along with its sample index and settings, based on the assumption that people are likely to copy patterns while editing their projects.

Another small optimization in the encoding is the use of gating bits. You can pan samples, adjust their volume, and set the FX send value to enable the delay effect on a per-row basis. However, realistically, most people won't adjust these settings for many or even most samples. We can use a single bit to signify that a setting has its default value, which saves us between 3 and 6 extra bits we would have needed to encode the value. In other words, optimize for the default case.

In order to efficiently encode the timeline, I used a run-length encoding. This works on the assumption that patterns will typically be off for a number of steps, and then on for some number of steps, and off again for a number of steps. For example a specific pattern may only be on for 16 bars out of a 128 bar song. It would be very wasteful to take 128 bits to store that information. Instead we can just store how long the pattern is off, and then how long the pattern is on, in an alternating fashion. The encoding of a row stops after its last active run, meaning we don't need to store any data for the empty space after it. To make this representation compact, variable-length integers are used, with groups of 3 payload bits and one continuation bit.

A friend of mine is a musician, and one feature he requested after trying the app was the ability to send a MIDI clock signal, which makes it possible to synchronize the drum machine with external music hardware. Fortunately, there is a Web MIDI API, and this is fairly easy to do. The API allows you to schedule message sends at future timestamps, which means that the clock signal can be kept in sync, even though JavaScript runs everything on the main thread. The same callback that takes care of scheduling sample playback every 100ms takes care of scheduling MIDI clock pulses. I've been able to test that this works reliably on my laptop with a Behringer TD-3 synthesizer (a TB-303 clone). The Web MIDI API is supported on Chrome/Chromium, but sadly not on Safari. It's also much more annoying to get working on Firefox due to terrible Mozilla decision making, requiring users to manually install a plugin to enable Web MIDI support for each website.

I hope that you enjoy playing with this drum machine as much as I do. I'm very happy with the way it sounds, and the fact that it's usable even on a mobile phone. Groovie is on GitHub. I'd like to invite pull requests for new samples, with the caveat that those need to be public domain / uncopyrighted / CC0 to make it safe to distribute them with the app. The app could use more percussive sounds, environmental sounds, metallic sounds, and vocal one-shots. One possible source of samples could be movies, songs and games that are out of copyright. You can also record synths or things around your house and contribute that if you want to. I'm also very curious to hear any beat or track you create with Groovie. Please share the links, and I'll add them to Groovie's corpus.

sentences.zh: 为方便起见，歌曲标题采用人类可读的格式进行编码，其中空格替换为下划线，并有意排除 Markdown 字符，以避免在 Markdown 文档中包含链接时出现潜在的格式错误。

sentences.en: Groovie's encoding uses 4 bits to write a version number, which means there's room for incrementing this number to add new features or encoding improvements to Groovie without breaking older shared links.
sentences.zh: Groovie 的编码使用 4 位来写入版本号，这意味着可以增加此数字以向 Groovie 添加新功能或编码改进，而不会破坏旧的共享链接。

blocks.html_en: A pattern with one row per sample, and say 16 steps in length, is mostly just a grid, which can be naively encoded as a bitmap. I say naively because if you have 32 samples and 64 steps in length, that's already 2048 bits, meaning we bust the 10,800 bit budget with only a handful of patterns and no other data. We also need to encode the index of the samples for each row, which at the moment I'm using 9 bits for, allowing for up to 512 samples. Then each row can also have stereo panning, volume and effect send settings, which also take a few bits each to encode. The timeline itself can also be essentially represented as a bitmap, with one row per pattern, and one bit for each position where a pattern could be playing or not. Groovie uses a few clever tricks to try to encode this information using far fewer bits than a raw bitmap.

sentences.en: A pattern with one row per sample, and say 16 steps in length, is mostly just a grid, which can be naively encoded as a bitmap.
sentences.zh: 每个样本一行、长度为 16 步的模式大部分只是一个网格，可以简单地编码为位图。

sentences.en: I say naively because if you have 32 samples and 64 steps in length, that's already 2048 bits, meaning we bust the 10,800 bit budget with only a handful of patterns and no other data.
sentences.zh: 我这么说是天真的，因为如果你有 32 个样本和 64 个步长，那已经是 2048 位，这意味着我们只用少数模式而没有其他数据就超出了 10,800 位预算。

sentences.en: We also need to encode the index of the samples for each row, which at the moment I'm using 9 bits for, allowing for up to 512 samples.
sentences.zh: 我们还需要对每行的样本索引进行编码，目前我使用 9 位，最多允许 512 个样本。

sentences.en: Then each row can also have stereo panning, volume and effect send settings, which also take a few bits each to encode.
sentences.zh: 然后，每一行还可以有立体声声像、音量和效果发送设置，每个设置也需要一些位进行编码。

sentences.en: The timeline itself can also be essentially represented as a bitmap, with one row per pattern, and one bit for each position where a pattern could be playing or not.
sentences.zh: 时间线本身也可以本质上表示为位图，每个模式占一行，每个模式可能正在播放或不播放的位置对应一个位。

sentences.en: Groovie uses a few clever tricks to try to encode this information using far fewer bits than a raw bitmap.
sentences.zh: Groovie 使用一些巧妙的技巧来尝试使用比原始位图少得多的位来编码此信息。

blocks.html_en: <figcaption>A pattern is a grid of on/off steps, which can be naively represented as a bitmap</figcaption>

sentences.en: A pattern is a grid of on/off steps, which can be naively represented as a bitmap
sentences.zh: 模式是开/关步骤的网格，可以简单地表示为位图

blocks.html_en: When trying to optimize something, I think it's very helpful to have a set of benchmarks to give you useful metrics. I used a coding assistant to put together a corpus with about a dozen different songs, as well as a utility script to measure how many bytes are needed to encode each song, along with the total for the whole corpus. What quickly became clear is that most of the data that needs to be encoded is in the patterns. Here there are many tricks that we can use. Patterns are often repetitive, for example with a kick drum that repeats every N steps. They can also be sparse, for example with a cymbal hit that happens only once in a 16-step pattern. Or you can have the same kick drum beat reused in multiple patterns.

sentences.en: When trying to optimize something, I think it's very helpful to have a set of benchmarks to give you useful metrics.
sentences.zh: 当尝试优化某些东西时，我认为拥有一组基准来为您提供有用的指标非常有帮助。

sentences.en: I used a coding assistant to put together a corpus with about a dozen different songs, as well as a utility script to measure how many bytes are needed to encode each song, along with the total for the whole corpus.
sentences.zh: 我使用编码助手将大约十几首不同歌曲的语料库放在一起，并使用实用脚本来测量对每首歌曲进行编码需要多少字节，以及整个语料库的总数。

sentences.en: What quickly became clear is that most of the data that needs to be encoded is in the patterns.
sentences.zh: 很快就清楚的是，大多数需要编码的数据都在模式中。

sentences.en: Here there are many tricks that we can use.
sentences.zh: 这里有很多我们可以使用的技巧。

sentences.en: Patterns are often repetitive, for example with a kick drum that repeats every N steps.
sentences.zh: 模式通常是重复的，例如底鼓每 N 个步重复一次。

sentences.en: They can also be sparse, for example with a cymbal hit that happens only once in a 16-step pattern.
sentences.zh: 它们也可以是稀疏的，例如铙钹敲击在 16 步模式中只发生一次。

sentences.en: Or you can have the same kick drum beat reused in multiple patterns.
sentences.zh: 或者您可以在多种模式中重复使用相同的底鼓节拍。

blocks.html_en: What Groovie does here is it uses a few bits, for each row of a pattern, to select among 8 different encoding strategies for that row. A variable-length prefix code is used to encode the strategy. One strategy is to just repeat the same short motif along the whole length of the row. Another is to record the exact position of sparse hits. There is also a fallback to storing a literal bitmap of the row. Then there is another strategy which reuses all of the data from the same row in the previous pattern, along with its sample index and settings, based on the assumption that people are likely to copy patterns while editing their projects.

sentences.en: What Groovie does here is it uses a few bits, for each row of a pattern, to select among 8 different encoding strategies for that row.
sentences.zh: Groovie 在这里所做的是，对于模式的每一行，它使用一些位来为该行选择 8 种不同的编码策略。

sentences.en: A variable-length prefix code is used to encode the strategy.
sentences.zh: 可变长度前缀码用于对策略进行编码。

sentences.en: One strategy is to just repeat the same short motif along the whole length of the row.
sentences.zh: 一种策略是沿着整行的长度重复相同的短主题。

sentences.en: Another is to record the exact position of sparse hits.
sentences.zh: 另一种是记录稀疏命中的确切位置。

sentences.en: There is also a fallback to storing a literal bitmap of the row.
sentences.zh: 还有一个后备方案是存储行的文字位图。

sentences.en: Then there is another strategy which reuses all of the data from the same row in the previous pattern, along with its sample index and settings, based on the assumption that people are likely to copy patterns while editing their projects.
sentences.zh: 然后，还有另一种策略，它基于人们在编辑项目时可能复制模式的假设，重用先前模式中同一行的所有数据及其样本索引和设置。

blocks.html_en: <figcaption>Four of the eight per-row encoding strategies, with the literal bitmap as the fallback</figcaption>

sentences.en: Four of the eight per-row encoding strategies, with the literal bitmap as the fallback
sentences.zh: 八种每行编码策略中的四种，以文字位图作为后备

blocks.html_en: Another small optimization in the encoding is the use of gating bits. You can pan samples, adjust their volume, and set the FX send value to enable the delay effect on a per-row basis. However, realistically, most people won't adjust these settings for many or even most samples. We can use a single bit to signify that a setting has its default value, which saves us between 3 and 6 extra bits we would have needed to encode the value. In other words, optimize for the default case.

sentences.en: Another small optimization in the encoding is the use of gating bits.
sentences.zh: 编码中的另一个小优化是门控位的使用。

sentences.en: You can pan samples, adjust their volume, and set the FX send value to enable the delay effect on a per-row basis.
sentences.zh: 您可以平移样本、调整其音量并设置 FX 发送值以在每行基础上启用延迟效果。

sentences.en: However, realistically, most people won't adjust these settings for many or even most samples.
sentences.zh: 然而，实际上，大多数人不会为许多甚至大多数样本调整这些设置。

sentences.en: We can use a single bit to signify that a setting has its default value, which saves us between 3 and 6 extra bits we would have needed to encode the value.
sentences.zh: 我们可以使用单个位来表示某个设置具有默认值，这可以节省编码该值所需的 3 到 6 个额外位。

sentences.en: In other words, optimize for the default case.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，针对默认情况进行优化。

blocks.html_en: In order to efficiently encode the timeline, I used a run-length encoding. This works on the assumption that patterns will typically be off for a number of steps, and then on for some number of steps, and off again for a number of steps. For example a specific pattern may only be on for 16 bars out of a 128 bar song. It would be very wasteful to take 128 bits to store that information. Instead we can just store how long the pattern is off, and then how long the pattern is on, in an alternating fashion. The encoding of a row stops after its last active run, meaning we don't need to store any data for the empty space after it. To make this representation compact, variable-length integers are used, with groups of 3 payload bits and one continuation bit.

sentences.en: In order to efficiently encode the timeline, I used a run-length encoding.
sentences.zh: 为了有效地对时间线进行编码，我使用了游程编码。

sentences.en: This works on the assumption that patterns will typically be off for a number of steps, and then on for some number of steps, and off again for a number of steps.
sentences.zh: 这是基于这样的假设：模式通常会关闭多个步骤，然后打开一些步骤，然后再次关闭多个步骤。

sentences.en: For example a specific pattern may only be on for 16 bars out of a 128 bar song.
sentences.zh: 例如，特定模式可能仅适用于 128 小节歌曲中的 16 个小节。

sentences.en: It would be very wasteful to take 128 bits to store that information.
sentences.zh: 如果用 128 位来存储这些信息，那就太浪费了。

sentences.en: Instead we can just store how long the pattern is off, and then how long the pattern is on, in an alternating fashion.
sentences.zh: 相反，我们可以以交替的方式存储模式关闭的时间，然后存储模式打开的时间。

sentences.en: The encoding of a row stops after its last active run, meaning we don't need to store any data for the empty space after it.
sentences.zh: 行的编码在其最后一次活动运行后停止，这意味着我们不需要为其后面的空白空间存储任何数据。

sentences.en: To make this representation compact, variable-length integers are used, with groups of 3 payload bits and one continuation bit.
sentences.zh: 为了使这种表示形式紧凑，使用了可变长度整数，其中包含 3 个有效负载位和一个连续位。

blocks.html_en: <figcaption>Timeline lane stored as the gap before each block of active cells and the block's own length, both written as variable-length integers</figcaption>

sentences.en: Timeline lane stored as the gap before each block of active cells and the block's own length, both written as variable-length integers
sentences.zh: 时间轴通道存储为每个活动单元块之前的间隙以及块自身的长度，两者都写为可变长度整数

blocks.html_en: A friend of mine is a musician, and one feature he requested after trying the app was the ability to send a MIDI clock signal, which makes it possible to synchronize the drum machine with external music hardware. Fortunately, there is a Web MIDI API, and this is fairly easy to do. The API allows you to schedule message sends at future timestamps, which means that the clock signal can be kept in sync, even though JavaScript runs everything on the main thread. The same callback that takes care of scheduling sample playback every 100ms takes care of scheduling MIDI clock pulses. I've been able to test that this works reliably on my laptop with a Behringer TD-3 synthesizer (a TB-303 clone). The Web MIDI API is supported on Chrome/Chromium, but sadly not on Safari. It's also much more annoying to get working on Firefox due to terrible Mozilla decision making, requiring users to manually install a plugin to enable Web MIDI support for each website.

blocks.html_en: I hope that you enjoy playing with this drum machine as much as I do. I'm very happy with the way it sounds, and the fact that it's usable even on a mobile phone. Groovie is on GitHub. I'd like to invite pull requests for new samples, with the caveat that those need to be public domain / uncopyrighted / CC0 to make it safe to distribute them with the app. The app could use more percussive sounds, environmental sounds, metallic sounds, and vocal one-shots. One possible source of samples could be movies, songs and games that are out of copyright. You can also record synths or things around your house and contribute that if you want to. I'm also very curious to hear any beat or track you create with Groovie. Please share the links, and I'll add them to Groovie's corpus.

content_html_zh:
2026 年 8 月 6 日

这是一篇关于我在过去几周整理的一款名为 Groovie 的新音乐应用程序的博客文章。 早在 2012 年，我就构建了 MusicToy，这是网络上最早的 JavaScript 音乐应用程序之一。 这是一个非常简单的音序器，使用五声音阶和一些样本。 它的设计对于初学者来说非常直观。 我之所以说最早之一是因为这个应用程序实际上早于 Web Audio API。 第一个版本使用现已长期弃用的 Mozilla 音频数据 API。 有趣的是，MusicToy 允许您在不使用任何后端的情况下共享歌曲。 它是一个完全静态的网站，但它可以将模式编码到 URL 的哈希/片段部分（一个很酷但仍被低估的网络技巧）。

从那时起，我创建了几个更先进的基于网络的音乐应用程序，其中最先进的是 NoiseCraft。 NoiseCraft 具有具有多种可选模式的音序器节点。 然而，从单个长模式构建歌曲是极其乏味的。 我觉得缺少一种将多个模式链接在一起的方法，部分原因是当时我不清楚如何在用户界面设计方面干净利落地做到这一点。 通过这个项目，我想最终解决这个问题。

Groovie 是一款鼓/节拍音序器应用程序，它使用样本并具有许多高级功能。 我建造它是因为我看到了市场上的空白。 网络上有许多鼓机，但大多数都非常基本，具有固定的鼓组和单一模式。 其中一些更先进，但它们通常充满广告或需要付费帐户。 少数不存在这些问题的高级软件通常具有令人困惑的用户界面。 Groovie 有 150 多个样本可供选择，多达 32 个模式，以及一个时间线视图，允许随着时间的推移对多个模式进行排序，并同时播放多个模式。 这些模式可以具有可变的长度并创建多种节奏。 它还具有低通/高通滤波器、延迟、每个样本的音量和平移等功能。 它在完成所有这一切的同时，保持了一个非常直观的用户界面，具有响应式布局，即使在手机上仍然可用，最重要的是，它是开源的，并且永远免费。

以下是一些示例片段/节拍：

  • 柏林科技安排
  • 钻和低音安排
  • 房子槽宽平移
  • 摇滚乐编曲
  • 经典的阿门休息
  • 鼓和贝斯的节奏

与 MusicToy 一样，Groovie 是完全静态的，并且将模式编码并直接投影到 URL 的片段部分中。 然而，它在该空间中打包了更多的信息，项目最多可以有 32 个模式、可选择的样本以及可以跨越数千个步骤的时间线。 因此，我真诚地努力巧妙地处理这些信息的编码方式。 我希望将链接总长度限制为 2000 个字符，以保持链接在社交媒体平台和消息服务上可共享，或者片段部分的预算为约 1800 个字符。 使用 base64url 编码，每个字符留下 6 位信息，总共 10,800 位。 我觉得这很令人鼓舞，因为我从经验中知道，你实际上可以用那么多位来编码大量信息。

为方便起见，歌曲标题采用人类可读的格式进行编码，其中空格替换为下划线，并有意排除 Markdown 字符，以避免在 Markdown 文档中包含链接时出现潜在的格式错误。 Groovie 的编码使用 4 位来写入版本号，这意味着可以增加此数字以向 Groovie 添加新功能或编码改进，而不会破坏旧的共享链接。

每个样本一行、长度为 16 步的模式大部分只是一个网格，可以简单地编码为位图。 我这么说是天真的，因为如果你有 32 个样本和 64 个步长，那已经是 2048 位，这意味着我们只用少数模式而没有其他数据就超出了 10,800 位预算。 我们还需要对每行的样本索引进行编码，目前我使用 9 位，最多允许 512 个样本。 然后，每一行还可以有立体声声像、音量和效果发送设置，每个设置也需要一些位进行编码。 时间线本身也可以本质上表示为位图，每个模式占一行，每个模式可能正在播放或不播放的位置对应一个位。 Groovie 使用一些巧妙的技巧来尝试使用比原始位图少得多的位来编码此信息。

当尝试优化某些东西时，我认为拥有一组基准来为您提供有用的指标非常有帮助。 我使用编码助手将大约十几首不同歌曲的语料库放在一起，并使用实用脚本来测量对每首歌曲进行编码需要多少字节，以及整个语料库的总数。 很快就清楚的是，大多数需要编码的数据都在模式中。 这里有很多我们可以使用的技巧。 模式通常是重复的，例如底鼓每 N 个步重复一次。 它们也可以是稀疏的，例如铙钹敲击在 16 步模式中只发生一次。 或者您可以在多种模式中重复使用相同的底鼓节拍。

Groovie 在这里所做的是，对于模式的每一行，它使用一些位来为该行选择 8 种不同的编码策略。 可变长度前缀码用于对策略进行编码。 一种策略是沿着整行的长度重复相同的短主题。 另一种是记录稀疏命中的确切位置。 还有一个后备方案是存储行的文字位图。 然后，还有另一种策略，它基于人们在编辑项目时可能复制模式的假设，重用先前模式中同一行的所有数据及其样本索引和设置。

编码中的另一个小优化是门控位的使用。 您可以平移样本、调整其音量并设置 FX 发送值以在每行基础上启用延迟效果。 然而，实际上，大多数人不会为许多甚至大多数样本调整这些设置。 我们可以使用单个位来表示某个设置具有默认值，这可以节省编码该值所需的 3 到 6 个额外位。 换句话说，针对默认情况进行优化。

为了有效地对时间线进行编码，我使用了游程编码。 这是基于这样的假设：模式通常会关闭多个步骤，然后打开一些步骤，然后再次关闭多个步骤。 例如，特定模式可能仅适用于 128 小节歌曲中的 16 个小节。 如果用 128 位来存储这些信息，那就太浪费了。 相反，我们可以以交替的方式存储模式关闭的时间，然后存储模式打开的时间。 行的编码在其最后一次活动运行后停止，这意味着我们不需要为其后面的空白空间存储任何数据。 为了使这种表示形式紧凑，使用了可变长度整数，其中包含 3 个有效负载位和一个连续位。

我的一位朋友是一位音乐家，他在尝试该应用程序后要求的一项功能是能够发送 MIDI 时钟信号，这使得鼓机与外部音乐硬件同步成为可能。 幸运的是，有一个 Web MIDI API，而且这很容易做到。 该 API 允许您安排在未来的时间戳发送消息，这意味着即使 JavaScript 在主线程上运行所有内容，时钟信号也可以保持同步。 负责安排每 100 毫秒播放一次样本的回调同样负责安排 MIDI 时钟脉冲。 我已经能够使用 Behringer TD-3 合成器（TB-303 克隆）在我的笔记本电脑上测试其是否可靠工作。 Chrome/Chromium 支持 Web MIDI API，但遗憾的是 Safari 不支持。 由于 Mozilla 糟糕的决策，需要用户手动安装插件才能为每个网站启用 Web MIDI 支持，因此在 Firefox 上工作也更加烦人。

我希望您和我一样喜欢玩这台鼓机。 我对它的声音非常满意，而且它甚至可以在手机上使用。 Groovie 位于 GitHub 上。 我想邀请新样本的拉取请求，但需要注意的是，这些样本需要是公共领域/无版权/CC0，才能安全地与应用程序一起分发它们。 该应用程序可以使用更多的打击乐声音、环境声音、金属声音和单声声音。 样本的一种可能来源可以是不受版权保护的电影、歌曲和游戏。 如果您愿意，您还可以录制合成器或您家周围的东西并贡献出来。 我也非常想听听您用 Groovie 创建的任何节拍或曲目。 请分享链接，我会将它们添加到 Groovie 的语料库中。
